summary: Cardiol Therapeutics, a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing an at-the-market equity offering program under a sales agreement with Jefferies LLC as sales agent, permitting sales of up to US$75 million of common shares on the Nasdaq at prevailing market prices. Sales occur under a November 3, 2026 prospectus supplement to US and Canadian base shelf prospectuses dated September 15, 2026; no shares will be sold in Canada. Proceeds fund CardiolRx development, CRD-38, and working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any subsequent 6-K sale disclosures.
